attrs.evidence: REFUTED BY ITS OWN SUBJECT, 3 of 3. Every cell in the shipped table whose `kind` includes `Statistical` carries a non-empty `authority`: 24 ('escalate (per family, under a declared evaluator protocol)'), 27b ('admit further evaluation'), 34 ('publish aggregate'). And the certificate under which cell 24's authority is granted is ESC-N — KNOWN, in this ledger, bound to the same cell: zero observed violations in n i.i.d. tasks certify (eta, delta)-domination when (1-eta)^n <= delta. That is a TOTAL PREDICATE over a certificate, decided at a gate. THE STATED GROUND IS THE ERROR: it conflates the decidability of the GATE with the modality of the GUARANTEE. The gate is total; the guarantee stays probabilistic. `Environmental` is a further problem — it is named as a kind and occurs zero times in the table, so the record quantifies over a class with no members. This record's own evidence field said 'the table gives every cell an authority anyway', reading the disagreement as the table's fault; the adjudication is that the claim was wrong and the table was right. GPT-5.6's Mosaic audit found the over-breadth; the 3-of-3 measurement and the ESC-N collision are this round's.
attrs.finding: REFUTED. Cells whose kind is Statistical or Environmental cannot honour one, because no total predicate decides them at a gate.
